description: This Java class defines a REST controller for billing categories in a Spring Boot application. It provides endpoints to list, create, and update billing categories, acting as an API layer that communicates with a service layer.

classes.name: BillingCategoriesController
classes.description: REST controller for managing billing category endpoints, providing list, create, and update operations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all billing categories, including aggregate totals.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new billing category.

methods.name: updateRate
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update the hourly rate of an existing billing category.
